---
name: Protocol proposal
about: Propose a change to HTP semantics, wire format or conformance rules
labels: protocol
---

## Problem

What concrete Human ↔ AI transaction problem is not represented correctly today?

## Proposed observable behavior

Describe what an HTP implementation should observe, validate or publish differently.

## Affected protocol objects

<!-- Need, Projection, Authority, Evidence, Action, Witness, Fracture, Repair, live event, publication envelope, schema, other -->

## Compatibility

- Is the proposal backward compatible?
- Would an existing valid HTP record change meaning?
- Does the protocol version need to change?

## Security and privacy impact

Describe any effect on authority, provenance, replay protection, signatures, private/public publication, source trust or data disclosure.

## Provider neutrality

Could independent implementations and different AI providers implement this without relying on one proprietary vendor behavior?

## Proposed test vectors

Describe at least one positive case and one failure/adversarial case.

## Alternatives considered

What simpler or competing designs were considered, and why are they insufficient?
